<a id="text_row_top_lo"></a>
### [`text_row_top_lo`](../../../src/variables.asm#L74) `$4338-$434B`

*variable*

Text row address tables built by build_text_row_tables (14 rows): top-half screen address lo/hi ($4338/$434C) and bottom-half lo/hi ($4360/$4374). Row 0 = screen row 0, row 1 = screen row 1 (both with the bottom half at $DE00). Row k >= 2 = screen rows 2k-1 and 2k = map row k-2; row 13 = $8FE8/$9010, outside the screen.
